user.title: Sign in to SomToday
user.description:
**Step 1.** Open this link and sign in — SSO and MFA are supported:

{auth_url}

**Step 2.** After signing in, the browser goes to a `somtoday://…` address that Home Assistant cannot open. Copy it from the address bar. In Chrome the redirect may be blocked, so open DevTools (F12) → Network, click the request to `somtoday.nl`, and copy the `Location:` header.

**Step 3.** Paste it below — the full URL, the `Location:` value, or just the code.

data_description.redirect_url: Paste the full somtoday://… address, the Location header value, or just the authorization code.
